newsitem.title: USA: Delta Air says offering companion fares.
newsitem.headline: Delta Air says offering companion fares.

text.p: Delta Air Lines Inc said Tuesday it is offering first class companion fares this summer to Franfurt, Madrid and Manchester.
The First Class companion fares are one way and include a companion ticket.
The company said travelers must purchase its new first class companion fares from select U.S. gateways for travel departing May 21 through August 31.

From Atlanta they are $4,386 to Frankfurt, $4,466 to Madrid, $5,258 to Manchester; from Cincinnati the fare to Frankfurt is $4,894; and from New York's Kennedy Airport the fares are $3,104 to Madrid and $5,106 to Manchester.

Tickets must be purchased seven days prior to departure. One companion is permitted for each fare-paying passenger, and the companion and the fare-paying passenger must travel together on each flight segment. The fares are fully refundable.
